name: vscode-ols
description: Hover over ontology term IRIs, CURIEs (GO:0008150) and OBO short forms (GO_0008150) in any file to see their label and definition from the EMBL-EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS).

commands.title: OLS: Open term at cursor in browser

ols.enabled.description: Show OLS hovers for ontology term identifiers.

ols.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the OLS REST API (no trailing slash). Point this at a local OLS4 instance if you run one.

ols.webBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the OLS web UI, used for the 'Open in OLS' links.

ols.restrictToKnownPrefixes.description: Only recognise CURIEs and OBO short forms whose prefix belongs to an ontology loaded in OLS (the list is fetched from OLS and cached for a day). Turn off to attempt a lookup for any PREFIX:0000000 or PREFIX_0000000 pattern. IRIs are always looked up.

ols.extraPrefixes.description: Additional CURIE prefixes to recognise, in addition to those fetched from OLS.

ols.language.description: Preferred language for labels and definitions (passed to OLS as 'lang').

ols.showDefinition.description: Include the term definition in the hover.

ols.cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long successful lookups are cached in memory, in minutes.

ols.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for requests to OLS, in milliseconds.
